name: mio-greeks-template
notes: Template, not a run config: no MIO Greeks run is approved yet. Added by the orchestrator; awaiting owner confirmation. ADR-0310 stage 2 Greeks diagnostics over ONE saved, closed MIO run directory. Replace the two PLACEHOLDER paths and nothing else changes the arithmetic. Diagnostics only: nothing here re-prices, sizes or reserves. Use from Python: MIOGreeksDiagnostics('greeks', params).run(None, {}) (the node reads run_dir itself and writes books.csv, cells.csv, exposure.csv and greeks-summary.json under out_dir). The window ends 2021-06-30 and sealed_from is 2021-07-01: the four selection quarters (2019Q4, 2020Q1, 2021Q1, 2021Q2) only, and the tool refuses any book dated on or after sealed_from or outside the window (RE-ENTRY: no 2022-2023 MIO economics before the 3 picks; no 2024+ data, A0003).

greeks.notes: run_dir is opened read-only (result.json, trades.csv, daily-account.csv and the pinned chain/bar files it names; never run.log); out_dir must be a NEW place outside run_dir. methods are the four WSL formulations. beta_min_pairs must equal the run's correlation_min_pairs (20 in the WSL jobs) and chain_cache_days only bounds memory. beta_lookback must equal each shock method's own shock.beta_lookback (60 in the WSL jobs); nominal_lp declares none, so this value is used and flagged in the summary. multiplier must equal the run's own solver multiplier (refused otherwise). rate 0.0 is stated in the output; the forward is the chain-implied parity forward (rate, dividend and borrow absorbed), falling back to spot with a forward_spot flag. dte_edges are half-open day buckets [lo, hi); the last edge bounds a monthly-only name's 3rd expiry. cell_by is the A0006 cell (ticker, cadence, expiry rank): rank and cadence are both required (cell_by_incomplete), because a weekly name's rank 2 and a monthly name's position 2 are different scales; rank is the listed position (ADR-0310 A1, option (a)), which differs from the A0006 text (the 7-day windows) exactly when a listed week is skipped: flagged for the owner, path.csv untouched. min_total_usd nulls a cell's net share when |total P&L| is below it (the gross share is always given). The three hedge_* keys price the static delta-hedge column (hedge = -entry delta in shares, bought or sold at the fill close, unwound at the settlement close): hedge_fee_per_share is dollars per share per trade, hedge_half_spread_bps is per trade, hedge_borrow_rate is an annual rate paid only while the hedge is short stock (the book's delta long). They have no default (a default would be a hidden cost assumption); hedge_fee_per_share 0.005, hedge_half_spread_bps 5.0 and hedge_borrow_rate 0.005 are owner-accepted PLACEHOLDERS (2026-11-09: "Put that in for now but make note of it as a placeholder"); replace them with broker rates before any real use. Dividends come from the pinned bars' dividend_amount column when present; otherwise every row is flagged dividends_absent and its hedged_pnl is null (ADR-0310 A2.2). ADR-0310 A2 child keys: quarter (YYYYQn) is the DECISION quarter of the ONE quarter-arm this run directory holds (A0010); any requested book decided outside it refuses quarter_mismatch, a book is in the quarter it was decided in wherever it settles, and it is written in the summary; set it to the run's quarter. dividends is required (refuse dividend_column_absent, listing every requested symbol whose bar file lacks dividend_amount, before any P&L is read) or optional (this template: the forward path needs no dividend, A2.2 Q3(a)). seal_crossing is refuse (this template) or exclude: a book decided in the window whose fill or expiry falls on or after sealed_from (a late-June book settling in July) refuses with a dates-only census (n_crossing, per-method counts, each method/id/field/date), or with exclude is dropped before any economics is read and listed in the summary (seal_crossing_excluded, dates only), with n_books_excluded and n_books_total per method and unequal_method_sets and total_excludes_seal_crossing reported; a date past the window that is not such a crossing, or on or after 2024-01-02, still refuses window_outside_data_rights. Note that 2021Q2 books decided in late June cross the seal, so reading that quarter needs seal_crossing exclude (owner Q2 (b), explicit opt-in). ADR-0310 Amendment 2 stage 0 keys: hedge_cost_source is placeholder while the three rates are the recorded placeholders (measured is refused then: hedge_cost_source_mismatch); min_books (int >= 1) is the smallest cell or quarter read as not small; htb_lookback (int >= 6), htb_vol_threshold and htb_jump_threshold are the hard-to-borrow proxy, ADR-0312's names and its owner question 5 recommendation (20 / 2.5 / 0.75), identical in both ADRs' configs. ADR-0310 A2 stage 2a: every output row carries quarter; the summary's per-method direction_read is the method x quarter block ADR-0312 reads (n_books attributed, n_books_total and n_books_excluded around any seal-crossing exclusion, pnl and gross, static and payoff splits, forward_hedge counts and dollar effects, basis_usd, concentration over the ok-hedged books and concentration_pnl over all attributed). The forward hedge is sized from the DECISION session's Greeks (forward_hedge_status decision_unmarked when that chain cannot mark the book, counted in decision_greeks_refusals), struck at the fill forward, fee and half-spread only (no borrow); hedge columns are null off status ok and cell and summary sums run over the ok rows only. Descriptive only: development quarters, books shared across formulations.
